_comment: Source of truth for tools/gen_images.py. 'reference' images are sent to the image-edit endpoint so the result keeps their composition; scenes without a reference are generated from the prompt alone. Sizes are what the OpenAI image models accept (1536x1024 landscape, 1024x1536 portrait). Landscape scenes are centre-cropped to 16:9 when 'crop' is set.
style: Photorealistic photograph from one architectural photographer's series on a single honey-limestone country house: full-frame camera on a tripod, 35mm lens at f/8, eye height, verticals kept straight, deep focus near to far, available light only, faithful colour, gentle contrast, no HDR glow, faint fine grain. Never illustration, painting or CGI. No people, no readable text, no watermark.

scenes.prompt: Turn this drawing into a real photograph, keeping the composition and exact placement of every element: arched main gate dead centre, its arch between 57% and 70% of frame height; balcony window directly above it at 47-56%; round-arched ground-floor windows at 60-68% of height, left wing at 25-35% of width, right wing at 65-75%; round towers at 20% and 80% of width with a lit upper window at 35-42%; lake lower left, parterre lower right, gravel path straight down from the gate, tall trees framing both edges, mountains behind at right. Do not add, move or resize any window, door or tower. Neoclassical chateau of honey limestone ashlar with rusticated quoins and a string course, multi-pane sash windows upstairs, blue-grey slate roofs with dormers, two chimneys, a lantern cupola, a blank clock dial in the pediment, conical slate tower roofs with iron finials, a balustraded stone balcony, open oak doors spilling lamplight onto the terrace, lit iron lanterns. Golden hour: a low sun at right rakes warm light across the facade, shadows falling left; some windows glow amber from lamps inside, others reflect cool sky. A still lake mirrors house and sky, reeds at its edge; oak and lime foliage, dark yew mounds in the lower corners; clipped box hedges, round beds of pink and white flowers, a small stone fountain, fine jet; mown lawn. Scattered clouds lit peach from below under a deep blue zenith; exposed to hold the sky.

Empty trading floor fitted into the ground floor of the old house, at dusk, from the entrance doorway. The far wall is floor-to-ceiling glass in slim dark aluminium mullions over a hazy city skyline just after sunset: sky graded from a thin band of ember orange at the horizon to deep slate blue, tower window lights as small soft bokeh discs low in the glass, the brightest cluster to the right, the upper-left sky empty and dim. The old honey limestone wall runs plain along the left in soft shadow. Two rows of bench desks run toward the glass: white laminate worktops with black leather edges, brushed-aluminium arms each holding three matte-black monitors asleep, screens near-black with only a faint grey grid, dealerboard turrets with unlit keys, a headset, a ceramic mug, black mesh task chairs pushed in at slight angles. Polished dark terrazzo floor mirrors the screens and skyline; an unlit ceiling with black acoustic baffles. The only interior light is one brass articulated desk lamp on the nearest right-hand desk, its 2700 K tungsten bulb pooling amber over a stack of blank paper and a black fountain pen and catching drifting dust; cool 6500 K dusk light fills the rest with blue-grey shadow and a thin haze. For the web overlay keep the upper 60% of the frame, strongest at the upper left, calm, soft and low-contrast with no bright points or sharp detail; put the lit lamp, the brightest towers and all detailed set dressing in the lower half and toward the right.

Old law chambers on the ground floor of the house, late evening, from the doorway. The upper 60% of the frame, strongest at the upper left, carries a title, a paragraph and four cards: keep it calm, dim and low-contrast, plain walnut fielded panelling with a dentil cornice and an aged plaster ceiling in soft brown shadow, no lamps, windows or highlights there. All detailed set dressing sits in the lower half and toward the right: a mahogany partners' desk with a worn green leather top and brass swan-neck handles; on it a lit banker's lamp, bottle-green cased-glass shade on a brass column, a brass inkstand, a leather blotter and buff briefs tied with faded pink tape; behind it a button-back Chesterfield chair in oxblood leather; lower right, black japanned deed boxes on the floor and a brass fender before a cast-iron grate with dying embers, green velvet curtains drawn over the round-arched window at the right edge, no daylight. Lower left: the bottom shelves of a glazed bookcase of calf and half-morocco law reports with raised bands and gilt tooling, spines illegible, upper shelves fading into shadow. Wide dark oak boards under a threadbare burgundy-and-indigo Turkey rug. The lamp's 2700 K tungsten pool is the key light, green cast upward, amber downward; the ember glow a second warm accent at right; dust motes in the beam, faint haze, soft reflections in brass and polished wood, patina throughout.

Large private library filling a round tower room of the house at sunset, from the doorway, looking across the room. Floor-to-ceiling waxed dark oak bookcases with fluted pilasters and a dentil cornice follow the gently curved wall, packed with calf, morocco and cloth bindings in oxblood, tan, bottle green and faded navy, blind-tooled spines with no legible lettering. A low amber sun, about 3000 K, through a tall round-arched window just beyond the right edge of frame lays one long shaft across the parquet, table and lower right shelves; fine dust drifts in the beam; the rest of the room in soft open shade. The upper 60% of the frame, above all the upper left, must stay calm and low-contrast: upper shelves receding into even dim warm shadow, a plaster cove in gentle gloom, no window, lamp or bright highlight there, because a title and cards overlay it. All sharp detail and set dressing sits in the lower half, toward the right: a mahogany library table with an olive tooled-leather top, a lit brass banker's lamp with a green glass shade, 2700 K tungsten, a terrestrial globe on a turned stand with a brass meridian ring, a closed vellum folio, a worn cognac leather wing chair, a tall oak rolling ladder on cast-brass wheels and a brass rail against the right-hand shelves, a faded red-and-indigo Persian rug on herringbone oak parquet that reflects the lamp.

Empty drawing room on the piano nobile of the house, Louis XVI revival, from the doorway, exposed for the walls so the windows glow yet the sheers keep their weave. Painted boiserie: powder-blue panels in cream mouldings with a thin gilt fillet, cream dado rail, white egg-and-dart cornice, pale ceiling with a plaster rose. Two tall round-arched French windows on the right wall open onto the stone balustraded balcony, floor-length sheer white muslin, pale blue silk drapes tied back on brass poles, the glazing a soft blur of sky, treetops and the lake. Low morning sun through the right-hand window lays warm parallelograms across honeyed herringbone oak parquet and a faded blue-and-cream Aubusson rug, dust motes in the beam; cool sky light fills the rest, shadows open and faintly blue. An unlit crystal chandelier hangs upper centre-right, soft and low-contrast. Centre, low in the frame: a carved giltwood settee in pale blue silk damask and a marble-topped gueridon. Lower right, by the near window: a mahogany lady's writing desk with a brass gallery, blank cream sheets, a brass inkwell, a dip pen, a vase of white peonies, a gilt caned chair pulled out at an angle, crisp shadows on the waxed floor. Keep the upper 60% of the frame calm, evenly lit and low-contrast, above all the upper left, where the panelling is a plain soft field; put all detailed set dressing and hard shadows in the lower half and toward the right.

The English garden in the grounds of the house, beyond the parterre, on a still June late afternoon, exposed for the sky. A title, a paragraph and four cards overlay the upper 60% of the frame, strongest at the upper left, so that region must stay calm and low-contrast: a bright pale-blue sky with thin high cirrus, emptiest at the upper left, no hard cloud edges, no branches in the upper-left corner, only a soft hazy line of mature oaks, a copper beech and a cedar of Lebanon far behind at the upper right, the tip of one conical slate tower roof small and hazy above them at the far right. The clipped yew hedge line sits just below the middle of the frame; all set dressing sits low and to the right. Midground: a wide mown lawn with faint stripes and a deep herbaceous border of delphiniums, foxgloves, catmint, alliums, lavender and old shrub roses against a tall dark yew hedge clipped flat with buttresses. Lower right: a weathered teak Lutyens bench, slats silvered and speckled with lichen, set in a yew alcove under the overhanging hedge, box edging at its feet, a hoggin gravel path with a mossy York-stone kerb. Lower centre foreground: a rectangular lily pond with worn York-stone coping, still dark water mirroring the sky, lily pads and a few pink and white water lilies, a lichen-spotted stone ball finial on the corner pier. Low sun from the right, warm 4000 K, rakes long soft-edged hedge shadows across the grass and edge-lights the border.

Bedroom in a round tower room of the house, late at night, from the doorway. Centre-right: a carved dark walnut four-poster bed, burgundy silk-velvet hangings tied back with tasselled cords, pleated cream silk canopy lining, cream linen sheets turned down, a folded burgundy cashmere throw. Right edge: a tall round-arched window of wavy old crown glass, heavy burgundy damask curtains drawn back to a narrow gap, cool blue moonlight at 4500 K as a pale wedge across the floor and bed foot. Main light: two brass bedside lamps with pleated cream silk shades, 2700 K tungsten glowing amber, pooling on marble-topped walnut nightstands. Floor: aged dark oak parquet de Versailles under a deep red hand-knotted wool rug with cream and indigo medallions. Lower right, in sharp detail: a cut-crystal carafe on a silver tray, leather-bound books with blank spines, leather slippers on the rug, a low mahogany bench at the bed's foot. The upper 60% of the frame, strongest at the upper left, stays a calm low-contrast field: the curved tower wall in faded rose-brown silk damask fading to shadow, a dim gilt picture rail, the shadowed canopy top and a dim coved plaster ceiling, no bright highlights there; all fine set dressing sits low and right. Faint haze in the lamplight, a palette of burgundy, cream, amber and midnight blue with true blacks; warm and restful.

figure._comment: Keyframes of the Fin Lab analyst, each edited from the original portrait so she stays the same person in the same seat. The web page crossfades between them.
figure.base_prompt: Photorealistic edit of the provided photo, same frame. Same woman: identical face, thin round black wire glasses, long loose near-black hair parted off-centre, small gold stud earring, black notched-lapel blazer over an open-collar ivory blouse, in a black mesh chair. Keep the set exactly: pale oak desk, black keyboard lower left, printed report with blue bar charts and a black-and-gold fountain pen lower right, blurred monitor edge at left, rear monitor with a red-and-green candlestick chart, cream wall with a white-framed print upper left, dark-mullioned window at right with a blurred overcast city skyline. Same camera: waist-up, eye level, about 85 mm at f/2, focus on her eyes. Same light: soft diffuse daylight on her face, cool window light from the right, neutral cool colour. No legible text, no watermark. Change only her pose and expression as described, nothing else:

frames.prompt: she has turned her head to face the lens, chin level, both eyes on the camera, a gentle closed-mouth smile: lips together, corners lifted a little, cheeks softly raised, a faint crease at the outer eye corners, brows relaxed. Shoulders and torso keep their three-quarter turn to frame left; hands low at the desk, below frame. Glasses, earring and hair over both shoulders unchanged; a small window catchlight in each eye, focus on the eyes.

she has turned her head to look straight into the lens and is mid-sentence: lips parted about a finger's width on an open vowel, upper teeth just showing, jaw relaxed, mouth corners lifted, no grin or laugh; eyebrows raised a touch, eyes bright and focused on the viewer with a small crease at the outer corners, catchlights in both eyes, chin level, head not tilted. Shoulders, hands, hair, glasses and earring unchanged; no hand gesture.

she has turned her head to look into the lens with a warm natural smile, a hint of teeth, the outer eye corners softly creased behind the glasses; her right hand is raised beside her right shoulder in a small friendly wave, palm open to the camera, fingers relaxed and slightly parted, wrist level with the shoulder and in the same focal plane as her face so both are sharp, elbow bent and tucked near her ribs so the black blazer sleeve stays at the wrist; her left forearm rests on the desk.

she looks straight into the lens with a calm closed-mouth smile, chin level; her left hand is raised to chest height, below her chin, in a relaxed presenting gesture, palm open and turned toward the candlestick-chart monitor at the left of the frame, fingers together, wrist loose, elbow tucked near her ribs, arm not fully extended; the hand lit by the same soft window daylight, a touch softer in focus than her eyes; right hand resting by the keyboard, shoulders unmoved, no added screens.

she has turned her head to face the camera squarely, chin level, caught in a relaxed blink: both eyes fully but softly closed, upper lids resting on the lashes with no squeeze or creasing at the corners, brows level, forehead smooth, the closed lids visible behind the thin round lenses. Lips gently together, calm and neutral, no smile. Shoulders, blazer lapels and hair fall as in the photo; hands low at the desk, below frame; same framing and crop.

she has turned her face from the monitor to look straight into the lens, head tilted a few degrees toward her left shoulder on the window side, chin level, brows softly lifted as if listening, eyes attentive behind the round glasses with the same window catchlight in the lenses, lips closed in a small warm smile; shoulders, torso and posture unchanged, hair falling naturally with the tilt, hands low at the desk, below frame.

she has turned her head to look into the lens, a warm smile just beginning, lips together; her right hand is on its way up in front of her, at collarbone height and a little left of centre, palm turning toward the camera, fingers loosely curled and half open, elbow bent and tucked near her ribs so the black blazer sleeve gathers slightly at the wrist, the hand a touch softer in focus than her eyes; left forearm resting on the desk; shoulders unmoved.

she looks straight into the lens with a calm closed-mouth smile, chin level; her left hand is lifting off the desk toward the candlestick-chart monitor at the left of the frame, at the height of her lower ribs, palm beginning to open and turn toward the screen, fingers together, wrist loose, elbow near her body, arm not yet extended; right hand resting by the keyboard; shoulders unmoved, no added screens.
